QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] A Melody from a Dream
QuestInfo.0: #p1052203# keeps mumbling in his sleep and won't budge no matter how much you shake him. Since he's only half-awake, try asking #b#p1052212##k the secretary for the whole story.
QuestInfo.1: A few days ago, #b#p1052203##k dreamt up the most perfect melody, and he composed a song based on his dream. But #p1052203#'s agency doesn't have the funds or even a singer to bring the song to life. Will the song be nothing but a dream?
QuestInfo.2: #p1052203# sounds like he's desperate, but he hasn't given up hope. He still hums the melody in his sleep, after all.

0.msg: So... what was that with #p1052203# just now?

1.msg: Well, a few nights ago he told me the most beautiful melody came to him in a dream. After that, he shut himself up in his office to try and recreate it. It was almost like he was possessed...

2.msg: It looks like he's finally managed to finish the song, but I'm afraid there's no one to sing it and no funds to hire anybody.

3.msg: He poured his heart into that song. Is it truly destined to be forgotten? That's too sad to think about. Surely something can be done. #b#h0##k, why don't you talk to #b#p1052203##k?

yes.0: Ah, it looks like #b#p1052203##k is coming around. If you want to talk to him, now's your chance.

no.0: The song is too good to be simply be forgotten.

0.msg: Hey #p1052203#! Dia says there's a problem with your new song. Do you wanna tell me about it?

yes.0: There's nobody to sing it. I can't pay anyone... I'm afraid the agency's fallen on hard times. Perhaps the right tune came to the wrong composer. Funny how that works... I guess it's just not meant to be.
yes.1: Looks like I'm all washed up. I suppose it's time to pack it up before this place turns its back on me, just like Lady luck. Oh, and tell #p1052006# that I'm doing just fine. I'll eke by somehow. Maybe open a dry-cleaning shop.
